name: Ashford Velvet Reading Chair
vibe_description: A deep-tufted armchair upholstered in midnight-blue velvet with aged brass nail-head trim and hand-carved walnut legs. Evokes a private Victorian library — the kind of chair you sink into with a leather-bound book and a glass of port. Rich, intimate, and unapologetically scholarly.

name: Pemberton Carved Bookshelf
vibe_description: A floor-to-ceiling bookshelf in dark walnut with ornate crown molding and brass rail hardware. Instantly transforms any room into a private study. The deep mahogany finish absorbs light softly, creating that warm, moody reading-room atmosphere that feels both centuries old and perfectly curated.

name: Elsinore Writing Desk
vibe_description: A wide-topped writing desk with a forest-green leather inlay surface, antique-brass drawer pulls, and dark walnut frame with carved apron details. Built for the kind of person who writes longhand and keeps a globe on the corner. Heavy, serious, and absolutely gorgeous.

name: Dunmore Wingback Chair
vibe_description: A high-backed wingback in oxblood full-grain leather with deep button tufting, ivory contrast piping, and dark walnut turned legs. Commanding presence — this is the chair that belongs in a wood-paneled study beside a fireplace. Aristocratic, warm, and built to last 100 years.

name: Ravenswood Side Table
vibe_description: A compact drum side table in dark walnut with hand-inlaid brass banding and a single felt-lined drawer. Small in footprint, enormous in atmosphere. The perfect perch for a reading lamp, a leather notebook, and a cup of something warm.

name: Frigg Low-Profile Sofa
vibe_description: A low-slung three-seater in warm oatmeal linen with slender tapered birch legs and barely-there arms. No fuss, no excess — just clean geometry and fabric that gets softer every year. The kind of sofa that makes a room feel twice as large. Calm, functional, quietly beautiful.

name: Solveig Coffee Table
vibe_description: An oval coffee table in solid white oak with a smooth matte surface and knife-thin profile. Proportioned to float in a room rather than anchor it — exactly right for a living space that breathes. No hardware, no decoration, just beautifully figured wood and honest joinery.

name: Astrid Accent Chair
vibe_description: A round boucle bucket chair in warm cream with four delicate tapered oak legs. The boucle fabric is soft enough to run your hand across repeatedly. Somewhere between a hug and a piece of furniture — equal parts cozy and effortlessly minimal.

name: Bjorn Bookshelf
vibe_description: A tall open-shelving unit in solid white oak with adjustable shelves and a silhouette thin enough to disappear into the wall. The grain is pale and lively. Perfect for displaying a curated edit of books and objects without the room feeling cluttered.

name: Sputnik Lounge Chair
vibe_description: A molded lounge chair with a gently curved shell in burnt orange wool and splayed solid walnut legs. Lifted straight from a 1960s design catalog — the kind of chair that makes guests ask where you got it. Bold without being loud, retro without being costumey.

name: Helix Sofa
vibe_description: A three-seat sofa in warm camel leather with deep button tufting, knife-edge pillows, and eight tapered walnut legs. Every proportion is deliberate — the low back, the wide seat, the leg detail. This is mid-century done right, not as nostalgia but as good design that never went anywhere.

name: Orb Side Table
vibe_description: A tripod side table with a circular brass tray top and three tapered walnut legs. A classic mid-century form — and yet somehow it is always right. Sets down a drink, holds a plant, and quietly makes every room more interesting.

name: Walden Credenza
vibe_description: A long low credenza in solid teak with two cane-front cabinet doors, tapered hairpin legs, and a single center drawer. It floats above the floor with visual lightness. Perfect opposite a sofa or along a dining room wall — a horizontal anchor that holds the room together.

name: Wildflower Linen Sofa
vibe_description: A generously cushioned sofa in sage-green slipcover linen with wide rolled arms and turned bun feet painted cream. Intentionally soft and slightly imprecise — like it has always been here. Pairs with a floral pillow, a throw, and the feeling of a Sunday with nowhere to be.

name: Clover Wicker Accent Chair
vibe_description: A handwoven rattan accent chair with a thick cream-linen seat cushion and slightly splayed legs. Light enough to move, comfortable enough to stay in. The texture is the point — imperfect weave, warm straw color, the feel of something made by hands in a very good place.

name: Rosehip Side Table
vibe_description: A small side table with a scalloped apron, turned legs, and an antique-cream painted finish with gentle distressing at the edges. The kind of table that holds a bud vase, a half-finished candle, and a library book. Quiet, sweet, and completely of its world.

name: Ironworks Dining Table
vibe_description: A dining table built on a welded matte-black steel frame with a thick reclaimed Douglas fir top — two inches of solid, knot-filled, character-rich wood. Heavy, unmovable. The kind of table that gets scarred gracefully over years of dinner parties. Built for a loft or anyone who respects craft.

name: Pipe Bookshelf
vibe_description: Six-tier open shelving built on galvanized pipe brackets with reclaimed pine planks. Nothing is hidden — every bolt, every weld, every knot in the wood is the point. Perfect for a loft, a home office, or any space that values honesty over polish.

name: Gridiron Coffee Table
vibe_description: A welded steel coffee table with a flat matte-black frame and a thick smoked-glass top. Angular and uncompromising. Sits low in a living room and anchors the whole space with visual weight. No warmth is attempted and none is needed — this one earns its place through sheer presence.

name: Marrakech Pouf Ottoman
vibe_description: A hand-embossed leather pouf in burnt sienna with saffron medallion stitching. Stuffed firm, sewn by hand. It hits a floor and immediately starts a conversation. Layer three of them, pair with a kilim rug, and the room is somewhere else entirely.

name: Casbah Woven Side Table
vibe_description: A barrel-shaped side table hand-woven in natural jute with gold and terracotta geometric banding. The weave is tactile and slightly irregular — proof it was made by a person. A small but essential piece in any layered, global-inspired space.

name: Tangier Floor Cushion Sofa
vibe_description: A modular floor-level sofa built from three oversized cushion units in mixed jewel-toned Moroccan-weave fabric — saffron, indigo, and deep red. Arrange it in an L, a U, or a loose pile. The vibe is communal, opulent, and 100% intentional maximalism.

name: Mu Platform Bed Frame
vibe_description: A floor-hugging platform bed in solid ash wood with a barely-there headboard and edge detail so fine it nearly disappears. Sleeping low to the ground changes the geometry of the whole room — more space, more calm, more intention. Japandi at its most resolved.

name: Sabi Coffee Table
vibe_description: An asymmetric coffee table in solid black walnut with hand-planed surfaces and slightly mismatched leg heights — a deliberate nod to wabi-sabi, the acceptance of imperfection. The grain does all the work. Simple, grounded, and quietly extraordinary.

name: Ma Side Table
vibe_description: A small side table in white oak — one surface, one shelf, four legs. Named after the Japanese concept of negative space. The empty shelf is not a problem; it is the point. Everything about this table is a deliberate removal of everything unnecessary.

name: Dune Linen Sofa
vibe_description: A deep slipcovered sofa in washed sandy-beige linen with wide track arms and chunky turned legs in driftwood-grey. Looks like it has been in a beach house for twenty summers. Washable, forgiving, infinitely comfortable. The sofa that says: shoes off, nowhere to be.

name: Tideline Coffee Table
vibe_description: A rectangular coffee table built in driftwood-finished solid pine with a lightly whitewashed top that lets the grain show through. Not precious, not fragile. Put your sandy feet on it. Set down a wet glass. It only gets better. Relaxed, beachy, completely at ease.

name: Coral Rattan Chair
vibe_description: A large-frame rattan chair with a gently arched back, open weave sides, and a thick sea-glass-green cushion. The kind of chair that belongs on a screened porch with a view of the water, but works just as well in a living room that aspires to that feeling.

name: Gatsby Velvet Sofa
vibe_description: A fan-backed sofa in deep emerald velvet with gold nail-head trim along the curved frame, lacquered black legs with gold feet, and two geometric bolster pillows. Dramatic, symmetrical, unabashedly glamorous. This sofa does not blend in — it becomes the room.

name: Odeon Side Table
vibe_description: A three-tiered side table in lacquered black with a circular Carrara marble top and brass geometric cross-base. Each tier is a perfect circle stepped in size — pure deco geometry. Somewhere between a sculpture and a functional surface.
